sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The ball is controlled using the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, and the goal is to reach the end of each level without crashing into any obstacles.

The game starts off easy, but things quickly get challenging as the maze becomes increasingly difficult and the obstacles become more complex. The ball can move in any direction, but it's not too fast, making it easy to control and maneuver. As you progress through the levels, you'll need to use your reflexes and timing to avoid obstacles and reach the end of each level.

One of the most unique features of Rolling Ball is its use of power-ups and boosts. These can be collected throughout the levels and used to give you an edge over the obstacles.
